pages.title: Red Kangaroo
pages.text: The red kangaroo ($(o)Osphranter rufus$()) is the largest living marsupial, found across the dry plains and deserts of mainland Australia.$(br2)Males are usually reddish-brown, while females are often blue-grey. It can travel long distances at speed with little effort, covering several metres in a single bound.$(br2)Rival males settle disputes by boxing, balancing on their tails to kick.
